lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: It's nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Do I need to introduce myself?
Are you Aria?
Are you the popular opera singer?

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: That's me.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I'm glad to see you recognized me!

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Have you had a chance to catch any of my performances?
I'm afraid not.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: That's fine.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Our relationship won't be based on artistry,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: nor will it be terribly romantic.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Nevertheless, it'll be quite similar to putting on a big show.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: On that note, I'd like to give you tickets to Castle of Parma as a gift.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: ticket.rropera.com/MobileTicket493S0A67F5
Weren't tickets sold out?
Thank you.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: However, they always reserve a few seats for friends and family of the cast.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: No problem.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: If you want to get to know me,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: seeing me on stage will do more good than hours of conversation.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: You might be able to get a sense of how to interact with me.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: So long, then.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: The intermission is about to end.
Good luck with the rest of the performance.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I hope the rest of your day goes well,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}
